why: A delivers the modern, sober black, dark wood and gray look: a dark wood desk, a black ergonomic mesh chair, a truly low wide bookcase and a black lamp, with only minor misses in the bookcase's light wood top and the reception-style armchair. B drifts warm and traditional with a reddish desk, an executive wingback chair instead of an ergonomic one, a small narrow shelf and a brown nailhead recliner that clashes with the modern brief.
